summary: American Outdoor Brands filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, announcing that its Board approved a new share repurchase program authorizing up to $10.0 million of common stock, running from October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027. The prior $10.0 million program, initiated in 2025, repurchased 236,907 shares at an average $8.15, roughly $1.9 million. Repurchases may occur via open market, block, or privately negotiated transactions. No premium, price, or advisor is stated. Watch execution pace and liquidity support for AOUT shares.
